verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.pt: Ordena aos filhos de Israel que lancem para fora do arraial a todo leproso, e a todo o que padece fluxo, e a todo o que está oriundo por ter tocado num morto;
verses.en_web: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has an issue, and whoever is unclean by the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Give orders to the children of Israel to put outside the tent-circle every leper, and anyone who has any sort of flow from his body, and anyone who is unclean from the touch of the dead;

verses.en: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.pt: tanto homem como mulher os lançareis para fora, sim, para fora do arraial os lançareis; para que não contaminem o seu arraial, no meio do qual eu habito.
verses.en_web: Both you shall put male and female outside of the camp; that they not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”
verses.en_bbe: Male or female they are to be put outside the tent-circle, so that they may not make unclean my resting-place among them.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Assim fizeram os filhos de Israel, lançando-os para fora do arraial; como o Senhor falara a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had said to Moses, and put them outside the tent-circle.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Dize aos filhos de Israel: Quando homem ou mulher pecar contra o seu próximo, transgredindo os mandamentos do Senhor, e tornando-se assim culpado,
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
verses.pt: confessará o pecado que tiver cometido, e pela sua culpa fará plena restituição, e ainda lhe acrescentará a sua quinta parte; e a dará àquele contra quem se fez culpado.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty;
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman does any of the sins of men, going against the word of the Lord, and is in the wrong;

verses.en: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.pt: Mas, se esse homem não tiver parente chegado, a quem se possa fazer a restituição pela culpa, esta será feita ao Senhor, e será do sacerdote, além do carneiro da expiação com que se fizer expiação por ele.
verses.en_web: then he shall confess his sin which he has done, and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
verses.en_bbe: Let them say openly what they have done; and make payment for the wrong done, with the addition of a fifth part, and give it to him to whom the wrong was done.

verses.en: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente toda oferta alçada de todas as coisas consagradas dos filhos de Israel, que estes trouxerem ao sacerdote, será dele.
verses.en_web: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.
verses.en_bbe: But if the man has no relation to whom the payment may be made, then the payment for sin made to the Lord will be the priest's, in addition to the sheep offered to take away his sin.

verses.en: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.pt: Enfim, as coisas consagradas de cada um serão do sacerdote; tudo o que alguém lhe der será dele.
verses.en_web: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.
verses.en_bbe: And every offering lifted up of all the holy things which the children of Israel give to the priest, will be his.

verses.en: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Every man’s holy things shall be his: whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”
verses.en_bbe: And every man's holy things will be his: whatever a man gives to the priest will be his.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Se a mulher de alguém se desviar pecando contra ele,
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.pt: e algum homem se deitar com ela, sendo isso oculto aos olhos de seu marido e conservado encoberto, se ela se tiver contaminado, e contra ela não houver testemunha, por não ter sido apanhada em flagrante;
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray, and is unfaithful to him,
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel, If any man's wife does wrong, sinning against him

verses.en: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
verses.pt: se o espírito de ciúmes vier sobre ele, e de sua mulher tiver ciúmes, por ela se haver contaminado, ou se sobre ele vier o espírito de ciúmes, e de sua mulher tiver ciúmes, mesmo que ela não se tenha contaminado;
verses.en_web: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;
verses.en_bbe: By taking as her lover another man, and keeps it secret so that her husband has no knowledge of it, and there is no witness against her, and she is not taken in the act;

verses.en: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.pt: o homem trará sua mulher perante o sacerdote, e juntamente trará a sua oferta por ela, a décima parte de uma efa de farinha de cevada, sobre a qual não deitará azeite nem porá incenso; porquanto é oferta de cereais por ciúmes, oferta memorativa, que traz a iniqüidade à memória.
verses.en_web: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she is defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she isn’t defiled:
verses.en_bbe: If the spirit of doubt comes into her husband's heart, and he has doubts of his wife, with good cause; or if he has doubts of her without cause:

verses.en: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.pt: O sacerdote fará a mulher chegar, e a porá perante o Senhor.
verses.en_web: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.
verses.en_bbe: Then let him take her to the priest, offering for her the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal, without oil or perfume; for it is a meal offering of a bitter spirit, a meal offering keeping wrongdoing in mind.

verses.en: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
verses.pt: E o sacerdote tomará num vaso de barro água sagrada; também tomará do pó que houver no chão do tabernáculo, e o deitará na água.
verses.en_web: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will make her come near and put her before the Lord;

verses.en: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
verses.pt: Então apresentará a mulher perante o Senhor, e descobrirá a cabeça da mulher, e lhe porá na mão a oferta de cereais memorativa, que é a oferta de cereais por ciúmes; e o sacerdote terá na mão a água de amargura, que traz consigo a maldição;
verses.en_web: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will take holy water in a pot and put in it dust from the floor of the House;

verses.en: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.pt: e a fará jurar, e dir-lhe-á: Se nenhum homem se deitou contigo, e se não te desviaste para a imundícia, violando o voto conjugal, sejas tu livre desta água de amargura, que traz consigo a maldição;
verses.en_web: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.
verses.en_bbe: And he will make the woman come before the Lord with her hair loose, and will put the meal offering, the offering of a bitter spirit, in her hands; and the priest will take in his hand the bitter water causing the curse;

verses.en: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.pt: mas se te desviaste, violando o voto conjugal, e te contaminaste, e algum homem que não é teu marido se deitou contigo, -
verses.en_web: The priest shall cause her to swear, and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.
verses.en_bbe: And he will make her take an oath, and say to her, If no man has been your lover and you have not been with another in place of your husband, you are free from this bitter water causing the curse;

verses.en: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.pt: então o sacerdote, fazendo que a mulher tome o juramento de maldição, lhe dirá: - O Senhor te ponha por maldição e praga no meio do teu povo, fazendo-te o Senhor consumir-se a tua coxa e inchar o teu ventre;
verses.en_web: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband:”
verses.en_bbe: But if you have been with another in place of your husband and have made yourself unclean with a lover:

verses.en: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.pt: e esta água que traz consigo a maldição entrará nas tuas entranhas, para te fazer inchar o ventre, e te fazer consumir-se a coxa. Então a mulher dirá: Amém, amém.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;
verses.en_bbe: Then the priest will put the oath of the curse on the woman, and say to her, May the Lord make you a curse and an oath among your people, sending on you wasting of the legs and disease of the stomach;

verses.en: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.pt: Então o sacerdote escreverá estas maldições num livro, e na água de amargura as apagará;
verses.en_web: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”
verses.en_bbe: And this water of the curse will go into your body, causing disease of your stomach and wasting of your legs: and the woman will say, So be it.

verses.en: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
verses.pt: e fará que a mulher beba a água de amargura, que traz consigo a maldição; e a água que traz consigo a maldição entrará nela para se tornar amarga.
verses.en_web: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will put these curses in a book, washing out the writing with the bitter water;

verses.en: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote tomará da mão da mulher a oferta de cereais por ciúmes, e moverá a oferta de cereais perante o Senhor, e a trará ao altar;
verses.en_web: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
verses.en_bbe: And he will give to the woman the bitter water for drink; and the bitter water causing the curse will go into her.

verses.en: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.pt: também tomará um punhado da oferta de cereais como memorial da oferta, e o queimará sobre o altar, e depois fará que a mulher beba a água.
verses.en_web: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will take from her hand the meal offering of doubt, waving it before the Lord, and will take it to the altar;

verses.en: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.pt: Quando ele tiver feito que ela beba a água, sucederá que, se ela se tiver contaminado, e tiver pecado contra seu marido, a água, que traz consigo a maldição, entrará nela, tornando-se amarga; inchar-lhe-á o ventre e a coxa se lhe consumirá; e a mulher será por maldição no meio do seu povo.
verses.en_web: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.en_bbe: And he will take some of it in his hand, burning it on the altar as a sign, and then he will give the woman the bitter water.

verses.en: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.pt: E, se a mulher não se tiver contaminado, mas for inocente, então será livre, e conceberá filhos.
verses.en_web: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled, and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away: and the woman will be a curse among her people.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be that if the woman has become unclean, sinning against her husband, when she has taken the bitter water it will go into her body, causing disease of the stomach and wasting of the legs, and she will be a curse among her people.

verses.en: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.pt: Esta é a lei dos ciúmes, no tocante à mulher que, violando o voto conjugal, se desviar e for contaminada;
verses.en_web: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.
verses.en_bbe: But if she is clean she will be free and will have offspring.

verses.en: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.pt: ou no tocante ao homem sobre quem vier o espírito de ciúmes, e se enciumar de sua mulher; ele apresentará a mulher perante o Senhor, e o sacerdote cumprirá para com ela toda esta lei.
verses.en_web: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled;
verses.en_bbe: This is the law for testing a wife who goes with another in place of her husband and becomes unclean;

verses.en: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.pt: Esse homem será livre da iniqüidade; a mulher, porém, levará sobre si a sua iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.
verses.en_bbe: Or for a husband who, in a bitter spirit, has doubts in his heart about his wife; let him take her to the priest, who will put in force this law.

verses.en: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.en_web: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then the man will be free from all wrong, and the woman's sin will be on her.
